name: drive_stats_v1
description: Declared schema for every per-quarter Parquet file. Built from the union of all daily CSV headers in 2023 Q4 to 2026 Q3. A column not listed here stops conversion; see docs/decisions.md D-6.

columns.name: date
columns.description: Day of the snapshot (UTC)

columns.name: serial_number
columns.description: Drive serial number; one drive

columns.name: model
columns.description: Manufacturer model label

columns.name: capacity_bytes
columns.description: Drive capacity in bytes; empty when Backblaze reports -1 (capacity not reported that day)

columns.name: failure
columns.description: 1 on the drive's last day if it failed, else 0

columns.name: datacenter
columns.description: Backblaze data center code

columns.name: cluster_id
columns.description: Cluster ID (string, keeps leading zeros)

columns.name: vault_id
columns.description: Vault ID (string)

columns.name: pod_id
columns.description: Storage pod ID (string)

columns.name: pod_slot_num
columns.description: Slot in the pod (string, keeps leading zeros)

columns.name: is_legacy_format
columns.description: Backblaze format flag ('true'/'false')

columns.name: smart_1_normalized
columns.description: SMART attribute 1, normalized value; null if the drive does not report it

columns.name: smart_1_raw
columns.description: SMART attribute 1, raw value; null if the drive does not report it
